value.fairness: same bitwise CRC algorithm, byte layout and scalar shared-library ABI; C/C++/Rust baseline may optimize allocation normally; no original C objects linked into HIA
value.input_domains: zero runs, repeating text, seeded pseudo-random bytes, final partial chunk
value.latency: per <=4096-byte batch including file read, packing and component compute; not end-user P95/P99; nearest-rank quantiles
value.ordering: rotate arms by group plus algorithm index; reverse on odd groups
value.positive_gate: all functionality checks pass AND HIA median whole-process wall time (spawn through exit, including monitoring and JSON output) and pooled batch P99 do not exceed the fastest measured strong reference on both algorithms; descriptive host qualification only
value.resource_scope: native allocation-event differentials are separate from uninstrumented performance; whole-process peak RSS is not exact owner bytes
value.sampling: all raw samples; no retries, exclusions, cache eviction or outlier removal
value.scope: new two-TU C component in a real file-checksum CLI; common C host retained
value.switch_scope: local host boundary load and rejected load; no NDU authority or state-layout migration claim
value.training_scope: separate fixed input; same training algorithms and byte counts for C, C++ and Rust
